CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship over Creation.
   B. Use Stewardship over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stewardship over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Stewardship over Creation has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.
   B. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.
   C. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.
   D. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.
   C. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

7. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.
   C. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Functions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Functions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Functions of the Bible.
   C. Say Functions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Functions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   B. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.
   C. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Gambling 6 6.5 Social Media 7 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note: The suggested nu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
